changes.title: Updates: a "What's new in build N" button for the build you are on
changes.detail:
The Updates page could tell you about builds you have not installed yet, but had no single place to read about the one already running. The top block now has a small button, "What's new in build 509", that opens that build's page on the public updates log. It is worked out from the running version, so it follows every update without being told. If the version has no build number, the button is not shown.

Not yet seen in a browser on a real build.
changes.detail_yue:
更新：加一粒「N 版本有乜新嘢」掣，講你而家用緊嗰個版本

更新頁識得講你未裝嘅版本，但係冇一個地方講你而家行緊嗰個。頂部 嗰格而家多咗一粒細掣「509 版本有乜新嘢」，會開公開更新日誌入面 嗰個版本嗰一頁。佢係由行緊嘅版本號計出嚟，所以每次更新之後自己 跟住變。版本號冇建置編號就唔顯示呢粒掣。

未喺真實版本嘅瀏覽器入面睇過。

changes.title: Updates: Notes on a system update opens its page on the updates log
changes.detail:
The Notes button beside Core, Supervisor and the operating system used whatever link the update happened to carry, which for the operating system was nowhere useful. It now opens that build's own page on the public updates log, found from the build number at the end of the version (2026.11.1.509 and 18.5.481 both end in theirs). Integrations and apps keep the link their author gave. A version with no build number falls back to the old behaviour.

One small test pins the version-to-page rule.
changes.detail_yue:
更新：系統更新嘅「說明」會開返更新日誌入面嗰一頁

核心、監督程式同作業系統旁邊個「說明」掣，以前係更新本身帶住 乜嘢連結就用乜嘢，作業系統嗰個根本去唔到有用嘅地方。而家會開 公開更新日誌入面嗰個版本自己嗰一頁，靠版本號最尾嗰個建置編號 嚟搵（2026.11.1.509 同 18.5.481 都係以自己個編號收尾）。整合同 應用程式照用返作者畀嘅連結。版本號冇建置編號就用返舊做法。

加咗一個細測試釘實「版本號去邊一頁」呢條規則。
